Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and
select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
The period from 1858-1905 was the seed time of Indian nationalism; and the early nationalists
(1) ________ the seeds well and deep. Instead of basing their nationalism or appeals to (2)

than divided the different sections of the people. Later on, the Indian people could gather
around this programme and wage powerful struggles.

from the statements.

Both conclusions II and III follow.
